955-2105-4598-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.

955-2105-4598-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Essence Flux from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Essence Flux from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Essence Flux, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

Give Shalai and Hallar lifelink, if needed.
Gain life.

Shalai and Hallar triggers, dealing damage to an opponent and causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 3.

Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, God-Eternal Oketra triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

Repeat.

When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Seed the Land triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

Resolve the Spider-Man trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Y'shtola Rhul triggers, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk with a lore counter on it.
The Legend of Kuruk's first chapter ability triggers, causing you to scry 2 and draw a card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting a lore counter on it. Its second chapter ability then triggers, causing you to scry 2 and draw a card.
Activate Viral Drake by paying {3}{U}, causing you to proliferate and put a lore counter on The Legend of Kuruk.
The Legend of Kuruk's third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

Activate Myr Scrapling by sacrificing it.
When Myr Scrapling dies, Mortuary and Carmen trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Myr Scrapling from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Carmen trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Carmen.
Resolve the Myr Scrapling ability.
Cast Myr Scrapling from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

Activate Goblin Medics by tapping it, adding {U}.
Goblin Medics triggers, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Goblin Medics.
Repeat.

Activate the artifact cast in step 1 by sacrificing it.

Repeat.

3967-5747-6243--123.easyPrerequisites:
You have enough mana to cast the Vehicle with MV >= 3.
The number of artifacts you control is equal to or greater than the Vehicle's crew number minus 2.
3967-5747-6243--123.description:
Cast the Vehicle by paying its mana cost.
When the Vehicle enters the battlefield, Simulacrum Synthesizer triggers, creating a 0/0 Construct artifact creature token that gets +1/+1 for each artifact you control.
Activate the Vehicle's crew ability by tapping the Construct, causing the Vehicle to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the Vehicle.
When the Vehicle dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning the Vehicle from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not be an Angel because the Vehicle is no longer a creature and cannot gain creature types.
When the Vehicle enters the battlefield, Simulacrum Synthesizer triggers, creating a 0/0 Construct artifact creature token that gets +1/+1 for each artifact you control.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat from step 3.

Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
700-1339-2034-2498-6739.notes: You can skip step 6 if you have mana available.
